subject: BUG-099: ModuleProgress.init() does not exist and 93 module pages call it
description: Every *.module.html under _app/wireshark/** and _app/houses/eye/forensics/** calls ModuleProgress.init({moduleId, hubKey}) on load. ModuleProgress.js exports no init, so all 93 throw TypeError and whatever init was meant to do (bind the module to its course hub key, register the visit) never happens. Confirmed 2026-08-12 against git HEAD, so it predates the access-gate sweep that surfaced it. Only one ModuleProgress*.js exists in the tree, so nothing is shadowing it. NOT a rename: hubKey has no home in the current API (exports are complete/reset/completeQuiz/getStats/getModuleProgress/isCompleted/updateStreak/trackVisit/migrateLegacyKey/copyLegacyKey), so the contract has to be decided before code. Fix must cover the component AND the 93 callers, and needs a check that progress actually records for a Wireshark and a Forensics module afterwards. Tracker: _docs/operations/BUG_TRACKER.md BUG-099. Annotated in place at _app/components/ModuleProgress.js above the export.
